name: Entur Geocoding
description: Forward geocoding, autocomplete, reverse geocoding, and NSR-backed transit-stop suggestions for Norway

dataSources.purpose: Search Norwegian places, addresses, POIs, and public-transport stops via Entur's geocoder; reverse geocode coordinates; preserve NSR stop identifiers for downstream transit flows
dataSources.dataSent: Search query text or coordinates (longitude, latitude), language, optional Norway-first country filter, multimodal stop mode, ET-Client-Name header
dataSources.dataReceived: GeoJSON-like features with names, coordinates, NSR and Entur IDs, stop categories, transport modes, locality/county context
